Tells the radius of one channel that [ChannelRadius](ChannelRadius) has set. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Print GetChannelRadius(channel)
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [EmitSound](EmitSound).
@returns The radius in units of the world, `0` for a channel that is over.
